sample_unit: patients (primary care patients and health care workers) completing first self-assessment

links.outcome: Suicide alert detection and research team response to acute suicide risk in chatbot users
links.effect: Suicidal alerts were received correctly in simulation; 9% (3/34) of patients activated the suicide alert and the research team intervened promptly with successful outcomes.
links.quote: Furthermore, 9% (3/34) of patients activated the suicide alert, and the research team promptly intervened with successful outcomes.

screen.reason: Evaluated a mental health chatbot deployed with primary care patients and healthcare workers, specifically testing its crisis detection/suicide alert escalation protocol which triggered clinician intervention.
